workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/pull/10293 (8-bit horizontal resampling, strong downscaling with LANCZOS): Image.resize of a 1237x811 RGB image to three smaller sizes

oracle.source: Pillow's own resample and resize tests, for the module https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/pull/10293 changes (it changes no test file); targeted tests only; two tests that decode a JPEG are deselected, because this build has no libjpeg

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 5% faster; 59% faster; 63% faster

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Python 3.12; libjpeg is not installed on this Mac and no Homebrew, so the build disables JPEG
